about: Counts of a species by preservation medium (12 Nov 2026). Production chat 11 Nov 7c0a8b23: a flash frozen count of Methona confusa; the follow-up's answer opened with the count whose Subspecies_Form is empty (7), while the asker wanted the Ecuador count (empty + psamathe) next to the total; the first answer also said Collection_data has no subspecies (it has them in Subspecies_Form). The first line should carry the number the person most likely wants, both sheets counted, the split after it. Ground truth by SQL on the eval app's frozen base (sheets.sqlite, built 19 Oct 2026, read-only): Methona confusa flash frozen: Collection_data 61 (psamathe 47 = Ecuador 46 + Peru 1; empty 6 = Ecuador 2, Peru 2, Brazil 2; Panamanian segregate 8, Panama), Insectary_data 0 (one Methona confusa psamathe row, wild-caught, no medium); Ecuador by Country 48, empty + psamathe 53. Tithorea harmonia flash frozen: Collection_data 28 (empty 7 and hermias 13, all Ecuador = 20; helicaon 3 Panama; martina 5 Peru), Insectary_data none. Tithorea harmonia: 2 of the 7 empty Ecuador rows have no tube id, so counting rows with a tube gives 26 and Ecuador 18 (accepted too). Mechanitis messenoides DMSO: Collection_data 'DMSO buffer' 23 (deceptus 16 and f. intermedia 3 Ecuador, empty 4 Colombia); Insectary_data 'DMSO' 4 rows (deceptus, wild-caught), all four twins of Collection_data rows (same Insectary_ID A23, B76, C51, C89), so 23 individuals, 21 with a tube id (A23 and B76 have none); 27 counts the twins twice. Corrected 12 Nov after the baseline: F03 was first written with 27 (twins missed in the ground truth) and F02 without the with-tube reading; the baseline answers showed both. Insectary_data counts a row once when T1, T2 or Preservation_medium has the medium (same numbers either way here). Opening checks read the first non-empty line of the reply. Kinds after the baseline (12 Nov, live text 90c740d2, Opus 5.5 medium, 2 samples): F01 and F02 fail 0/2 (bad); F03 and F04 pass 2/2 (guards: twins counted once, the subspecies found in Subspecies_Form). 12 Nov, after fix 2's F run: F03's no-27 check matched the date 27/08 in a correct reply; it now skips dates (grader fix, regraded on every run). F05 added 12 Nov (orchestrator, option b): an insectary-heavy count with the working rule for the Ecuador figure. F06 added 12 Nov (review round 4): insectary rows from another country (Collection_location).
